entries.title: Genesis 32:2
segments:
Mahanaim; this was east of the Jordan, and north of the river Jabbok. 
 
Angels are ministering spirits sent forth by God to minister to those who are heirs of salvation.

entries.title: Genesis 32:3
segments: Country Edom; south and south-east of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 32:7
segments: Jacob was greatly afraid; lest Esau should take vengeance on him for having obtained the birthright and the blessing.
Past transgressions are often remembered, and cause deep and pungent distress long after they have been committed.

entries.title: Genesis 32:12
segments: Supplication to God is one of the most sure and powerful means of influencing men and obtaining from them what we desire.

entries.title: Genesis 32:16
segments: Put a space betwixt drove and drove; this arrangement was adapted to make the deepest impression upon Esau's mind.  While Jacob put his trust in God, he was careful to omit no means of propitiating his brother that lay in his power.

entries.title: Genesis 32:20
segments: Prayer does not render needless the most diligent use of appropriate means, but encourages it, and is instrumental in its success.

entries.title: Genesis 32:24
segments: A man; one in the form of a man.

entries.title: Genesis 32:25
segments:
Prevailed not against him; that is, while he used such a measure of strength as belongs to a man. 
 
  Touched the hollow--was out of joint; by this touch he revealed to Jacob his divine power, and thus his true character.

entries.title: Genesis 32:26
segments:
Let me go; this was said to try Jacob. 
 
  I will not let thee go; Jacob, now understanding who it was that had been wrestling with him, felt emboldened to cleave to Him till He should bless him.

entries.title: Genesis 32:28
segments:
Israel; meaning a princely contender with God. 
 
  As a prince hast thou power with God; the Hebrew word employed here, and in the name Israel, has the two meanings of prince and contention, wrestling.  It seems to be designedly chosen to unite these two ideas.  This verse gives the meaning of the transaction. Jacob had wrestled with God in prayer, and prevailed; and thus he had also prevailed with the men whose anger he feared, as Laban and Esau. 
 
Fervency and perseverance in penitent, believing prayer, has great influence with God; it prepares the way for deliverance from present trials, and furnishes the best preparation for all which are future.

entries.title: Genesis 32:29
segments: Wherefore--ask after my name? implying his exalted and mysterious nature.  Compare
.  The name of God comprehends all his attributes.

entries.title: Genesis 32:30
segments: Peniel; meaning the face of God.  This Jacob says he had seen, showing that the one with whom he had wrestled was God in human form, the Angel of the covenant, the Messiah.

entries.title: Genesis 32:31
segments: Penuel; meaning the same as peniel.
He halted; limped, or was lame, in consequence of the touch of the Angel.
